verdict.rationale: Two MAJOR consistency issues prevent unconditional approval: (1) AT-016 expected outcome (7 install_complete records) directly contradicts Plan T3.4 + PV-5.C5 (5 install_complete records — only 5 OSS-local servers are installed; the 2 HTTP servers context7 + exa have no install step). (2) Acceptance Tests use an inconsistent OP-script naming convention (op_NN_<name>.py with underscore-padding) versus the convention declared in Plan T4.3 and Phase Validators PV-4 (audit_opN_<name>.py with no padding and audit_ prefix); without reconciliation the AT commands will fail. Both are correctable by amending the acceptance-tests.md to align with the Plan / Phase-Validator authoritative names. Zero BLOCKERs; cross-artifact triangle is otherwise coherent.

issues.location: acceptance-tests.md:303 (AT-016 expected outcome) vs plan-v1.md:559-578 (T3.4 description) vs phase-validators.md:379 (PV-5.C5)
issues.description: AT-016 (AC-FR-8-a coverage) says `mcp-events.jsonl` contains 7 install_complete records (one per server) after postCreate. This contradicts Plan T3.4 which installs ONLY 5 OSS-local servers (serena, mcp-openapi-schema, actionlint-mcp, terraform-mcp, gitnexus) — the 2 HTTP-transport servers (context7, exa) have no install step; they only have postStart auth-probe checks. Phase Validators PV-5.C5 correctly asserts 5 install_complete records. The AT-016 expected-outcome wording would cause the test to fail against a correctly-implemented postCreate.

evidence.quote: `mcp-events.jsonl` contains 7 `install_complete` records (one per server) after postCreate.
For each of the 5 OSS-local servers (serena, mcp-openapi-schema, actionlint-mcp, terraform-mcp, gitnexus), check sentinel_present AND binary_present
On install success: write the sentinel file; write a single `install_complete` event to `.claude/runtime/mcp-events.jsonl` (one record per server per install

issues.recommended_resolution: Amend AT-016 expected outcome to read: '`mcp-events.jsonl` contains 5 install_complete records (one per OSS-local install: serena, mcp-openapi-schema, actionlint-mcp, terraform-mcp, gitnexus). The 2 HTTP-transport servers (context7, exa) have no install_complete record; their availability is exercised by postCreate auth-probe (T3.2) and postStart readiness_probe (T3.5). The consolidated stdout summary still covers all 7.' Routes to finalize-reconciler → test-acceptance-author.

issues.description: OP-audit-script filenames are referenced under TWO incompatible naming conventions: (a) Acceptance Tests use `op_NN_<name>.py` with two-digit zero-padded ordinal and no `audit_` prefix (e.g., `op_06_redaction.py`, `op_09_url_credential.py`, `op_10_argv_leakage.py`, `op_02_consumer_mapping.py`, `op_03_zero_mcp.py`, `op_08_gitnexus.py`, `op_04_*.py`); (b) Plan T4.3 and Phase Validators PV-4/PV-5 use `audit_opN_<name>.py` with no zero-padding and an `audit_` prefix (e.g., `audit_op6_runtime_log_redaction.py`, `audit_op9_url_credential_rejection.py`, `audit_op10_argv_leakage.py`). Both conventions cannot be correct simultaneously — the AT commands will not resolve to real scripts if Plan/PV wins, and vice versa.
issues.recommended_resolution: Plan + Phase Validators agree (2 against 1); Acceptance Tests should be amended to use the Plan/PV convention `audit_op<N>_<descriptor>.py` (no zero-padding, `audit_` prefix). Concretely: AT-032 → `audit_op6_runtime_log_redaction.py`; AT-041 → `audit_op9_url_credential_rejection.py` + `audit_op10_argv_leakage.py`; AT-049 → `audit_op2_consumer_mapping.py`, `audit_op3_zero_mcp_invariant.py`, `audit_op8_gitnexus.py`, `audit_op4_primary_fallback_prose.py`. Routes to finalize-reconciler → test-acceptance-author. (Alternative resolution: amend Plan/PV to the AT convention — but Plan declares the contract first and PV consumes it; flipping both is the larger change.)

issues.description: AT-043 maps to `AC-NFR-4` which is NOT a Blueprint v3 AC. Blueprint v3 has exactly 51 formal AC declarations (AC-FR-*, AC-CC-*, AC-CS-*, AC-NFR-1/2/-*, AC-X-*); the PRD's NFR-4 commentary was deliberately reframed at PRD v2 (per I-DR-006) as a Blueprint-author instruction inside UI-7 rather than a runtime AC — there is no `AC-NFR-4-a`/`-b` either. The acceptance-tests.md overview asserts '51 of 51 ACs covered' which is technically true (all 51 Blueprint ACs ARE covered), but AT-043 introduces an extra map row for a non-existent AC ID. Plan §Acceptance Test Cross-Reference correctly omits AC-NFR-4. The acceptance-tests note at line 93 acknowledges the AT-043 mapping is non-standard ('reflected in the PRD's NFR list and tracked here per PA-OI-3').

issues.recommended_resolution: Two acceptable resolutions: (a) Rename the AT-043 mapping from 'AC-NFR-4' to 'PRD-NFR-4 (no Blueprint AC ID; tracked via PA-OI-3 and T4.7 OI-4 closure)' — preserves the PRD-NFR coverage intent without inventing a phantom AC. (b) Keep AT-043 but tag it as a methodology-coverage test rather than an AC-mapped test; update the matrix note explicitly. Both routes preserve the intent. Severity is MINOR because the phantom is acknowledged in the overview prose and Plan correctly omits the AC ID; the gap is cosmetic — the actual coverage is real (via T4.7 + PV-4.C19/C20).

issues.description: Overview says '49 unique tests (AT-001..AT-049) + 1 shared triplet test (AT-HG)' = 50 total. Per orchestrator brief metadata this is correct (50 tests, 51/51 ACs, AT-HG shared). However the AC Coverage Matrix lists 50 rows of unique-test IDs (AT-001..AT-049 = 49 IDs + AT-HG = 1 ID = 50 unique). The internal arithmetic is consistent (49 + 1 = 50), but the metadata block at line 91 says '49 unique tests + 1 shared triplet' which is a slightly loose phrasing (AT-HG IS a unique test ID; 'shared' refers to the AC mapping, not the test ID). No functional impact; cosmetic clarity issue.
